h1: Luxury Container House: Six Villa-Grade Sizes and Prices
seoTitle: Luxury Container House Price and Six Sizes in India | SAMAN
metaDescription: Luxury container house from Rs 4,36,480 ex-GST. Six sizes, 160 to 480 sq ft, villa-grade finish, engineered glazing, full wet core. Made in Bangalore and Noida.
opener: A luxury container house is the version of the platform where the finish schedule, the glazing and the wet core carry the same engineering attention as the steel. SAMAN builds it in six sizes, 160 to 480 sq ft, for buyers putting a second home on a farm plot, a rentable stay on a resort site, or a self-contained guest residence beside an existing house. What separates it from the standard container house is not a badge: the floor grid is locally strengthened under stone, tile and wet rooms so rigid finishes stay serviceable, posts and lintels are engineered around full-height glazing, and the roof frame carries cove ceilings and concealed services rather than hanging them off the roof sheet. Prices below are ex-GST, ex-works, and every size ships with a published room and opening schedule.
descriptionHtml:
Is this a design gallery or a product you can order

Search for a luxury container house in India and the results split in two. Half of them are inspiration boards and architecture features from other countries, showing one-off houses built by architects on site. The other half are listings from manufacturers. This page is the second kind. Everything shown here is a factory-built product with a published size, a published room and opening schedule, and a published price, made in SAMAN's own facilities at Bangalore and Greater Noida and delivered as a finished unit.

That distinction matters more than it sounds. A container house built on site by a contractor is priced after design; a factory build is priced before it. The six sizes on this page were drawn first and costed second, which is why every one of them carries a ladder you can read without a meeting. What you cannot do here is buy a one-off. If your brief needs a shape that is not one of these six, it becomes a project quotation with its own engineering, not a catalogue price.

It is also worth being clear about the word luxury, because the market uses it loosely. On this page it refers to a defined specification level: an upgraded interior substrate, a full wet core, engineered support around large glazing, and a controlled finish schedule. It does not mean a different steel platform from the rest of the range, and it does not mean imported fittings. Where the specification stops, the page says so.

What makes a container house a luxury build

Three lines in the structural schedule are specific to this build rather than shared with the standard range. The floor frame is a premium residential grid, roughly 100 x 50 x 3 mm primary and 80 x 40 x 3 mm secondary members, locally strengthened under stone and tile, premium cabinetry, wet rooms, wide openings and joined-villa lines. It is designed for deflection as well as strength, because a rigid finish stops being serviceable long before a floor is structurally in trouble. A heavy island, a tub or a safe needs a marked support zone.

The second is the opening structure. Corner posts of the 60 x 60 x 3 mm class are joined by engineered posts, lintels and sill beams around full-height glazing, sliders, cantilevered features and multi-module openings, and the unit keeps its transport stiffness before it is joined on site. Removable transport braces and the final connection frames are identified on the erection sequence rather than improvised.

The third is the roof frame: 60 x 40 x 2.5 mm class rafters and 50 x 50 x 2.5 mm purlins, with dedicated supports for cove ceilings, concealed ducts, sunshades and approved canopy interfaces. Decorative ceiling and lighting loads are carried by secondary framing, never by the roof sheet. Roof terraces, solar, pergolas and water tanks are separate structural packages and are quoted as such.

Everything visible follows from those three. Floors are 19 mm marine or BWP plywood, or 18 mm cement-fibre board, on a verified close-spaced frame, with a set-down, waterproof backer and threshold containment in wet rooms. Walls are lined in 12 mm moisture-resistant plywood or board behind premium laminate, HPL, gypsum, acoustic panels or wood-effect surfaces over an accessible service frame. Ceilings are 12.5 mm gypsum or premium laminated with cove and recessed lighting zones and access panels. The walking surface is 5 to 6 mm premium SPC or LVT in dry rooms and anti-skid tile in the bath and kitchen.

What a luxury container house costs in India

Prices on this page are ex-GST and ex-works, and they are derived rather than negotiated. The rate is set at a 200 sq ft reference and adjusted by area band: smaller units carry a premium because the fixed content of a kitchen, a bathroom and a service run does not shrink with the footprint, and larger units carry a reduction because that same content spreads further. The published ladder runs from Rs 4,36,480 at 160 sq ft to Rs 11,18,976 at 480 sq ft. Add 18% GST for the delivered-in-India figure.

That answers the two questions buyers usually ask in the same breath. A luxury container home in India, at this specification, starts a little over four lakh rupees for a genuine one-bedroom-equivalent suite and reaches about eleven lakh for a two-bedroom villa, both before tax. A 40 ft container house specifically spans Rs 7,53,920 to Rs 11,18,976 depending on whether you take the 8, 10 or 12 ft width. The width is the variable most buyers underestimate; on a 40 ft body it changes the price by nearly four lakh rupees and changes the plan completely.

Anything above 900 sq ft, which means joining units, leaves the published ladder and becomes a manual project quotation with its own structural and foundation design. Two 40 x 12 ft units joined on site are not simply twice the price of one.

Which of the six sizes fits your plot and your brief

The decision is rarely about area. It is about how many separations the plan has to make. Below 240 sq ft you are buying one volume with a screened sleeping end; at 240 sq ft the bedroom closes behind a door; at 320 sq ft a corridor appears and the wet core gains a utility bay; at 480 sq ft you get a second bedroom and a dressing lobby. Each of those is a step change in how the unit can be used, and each is visible on the drawing for that size.

Plot shape decides the rest. A 40 x 8 ft body suits a narrow plot or a run along a boundary wall, and gives the largest bedroom of any single-bedroom size at 101 sq ft, but it never feels wide. A 20 x 12 ft body on the same area gives a room that feels like a room. If the site can take either, look at the drawings side by side before looking at the prices.

Is a container house legal in India, and on what land

A container house is treated as a structure, not as a vehicle, so the approvals that apply are the ones that already apply to building on your land: the local municipal or panchayat building bylaws, setbacks, ground coverage, and any zoning restriction on the plot. A factory-built unit does not change what is permitted; it changes how the structure is delivered. On agricultural land in particular, the rules on permanent construction vary widely by state, and buyers should confirm the position for their own plot before ordering.

SAMAN supplies the unit. Approvals, permissions, site utilities, foundations and project-specific engineering or testing are excluded from the published price unless expressly included in the signed quotation. That exclusion is stated plainly rather than buried, because it is the single most common cause of a delayed installation. If a consultant is preparing your submission, the drawings on this page carry the overall dimensions, the room schedule and the opening schedule they will need to start.

This is general information about how the approval process usually works, not legal advice, and the position on any specific plot should be confirmed with your local authority or a qualified professional.

What the price includes, and what it does not

The published price buys the premium residential shell with upgraded lining, floor, ceiling, glazing and electrical density, and a compact wet-area allowance sized to the plan for that size. Read the drawing for your size and what is drawn is what is quoted.

Included in the published price:

  • Premium residential shell with the strengthened floor grid, engineered opening structure and roof framing described above
  • Upgraded wall, ceiling and floor lining and the finish schedule for that size, including anti-skid wet-area flooring
  • Powder-coated aluminium or uPVC windows and sliders with 6 mm toughened or laminated glass to the opening schedule
  • Electrical rough-in and fixed accessories to the approved layout: LED lighting, modular switches, 6A and 16A sockets, fan or exhaust points and an AC isolator provision
  • Plumbing rough-in, waterproofing, floor traps and the geyser and chimney provisions shown on the drawing
  • Factory inspection, functional testing and the pre-dispatch dossier with approved drawings, material schedule and photographs

Excluded unless expressly itemised in the signed quotation: designer facade packages, loose furniture, appliances, modular kitchen upgrades, branded sanitaryware, AV, fitted AC equipment and commissioning, decks, site work, foundations, utilities, craneage, approvals, and multi-unit villa joining.

Delivery, site readiness and installation

Lead time is 7 to 21 working days from the confirmed order and approved drawing, depending on the size and the finish schedule. Freight is quoted separately by distance band from the nearer of the two facilities, with a published band table on the Shipping tab, and delivery is free within Bangalore city and across Delhi NCR including Ghaziabad, Gurugram, Faridabad, Noida and Greater Noida.

The unit arrives as a completed body on an open trailer and is lifted into position. That means the approach, the standing area for the vehicle and the crane, and the bearing points all have to be ready on the day. Lifting and transport follow the approved method statement, rigging geometry and support-point drawing; forklift handling is permitted only where pockets and capacity are documented. Interior fit-out, wet tanks and loose items are secured before the unit moves.

Foundations, site utilities, craneage, unloading and installation are excluded from the published price unless expressly included. A 40 ft body over a boundary wall is a different site problem from a 20 ft body on an open plot, and it is worth resolving before the order rather than on the delivery morning.

Warranty, service life and the maintenance you must do

The structural warranty is 10 years. The finishing warranty is 1 year, extendable to 2. Both run from the dates and on the terms stated in the signed quotation and handover documents, and both assume the maintenance below is actually done.

What sits outside warranty is stated rather than implied: unapproved alterations, poor foundations, site water entry, utility faults, corrosive exposure, missed seal or coating maintenance, misuse and relocation damage. The coating system is the part owners most often neglect. Cut edges, site-drilled penetrations and crevices need the approved touch-up, and a coastal or high-moisture site needs an upgraded system specified before production, not after the first monsoon.

Roof drainage is the second. Overflow paths, gutter access, AC line routes and every roof penetration are left inspectable and are tested before the ceiling is closed, which is only useful if somebody looks at them once a year. Luxury appearance does not conceal drainage on this build, and it should not be made to.

How to brief this build so the quote is right first time

Four decisions move the price and the programme more than anything else, and settling them before the enquiry usually removes a week. First, the size, and specifically the width: 8, 10 or 12 ft changes the plan more than 20 ft versus 40 ft does. Second, the finish tier, because real wood, marble and imported finishes are priced separately from the published schedule. Third, whether AC equipment, the modular kitchen, branded sanitaryware and loose furniture are in your scope or ours, since they are listed inclusions rather than assumptions.

Fourth, the site. Access for an open trailer, a standing area for the lift, the bearing points and the utility positions decide whether installation is a morning or a fortnight. A photograph of the approach and a dimension from the road to the intended position is usually enough for us to say whether the size you want can actually get there.

Bring the drawing for your size to the conversation. Every figure on it is the figure we quote against, and marking it up is faster than describing a change in words.

Questions buyers ask about the luxury build

What is the price of luxury container homes in India?

SAMAN publishes six sizes from Rs 4,36,480 ex-GST at 160 sq ft to Rs 11,18,976 at 480 sq ft, ex-works. Add 18% GST. Freight, foundations, site work and approvals are quoted separately.

What is the cost of a container house at this specification?

The rate is set at a 200 sq ft reference of Rs 2,480 per sq ft and adjusted by area band, so smaller units cost more per sq ft and larger units less. The six published figures already have that adjustment applied.

What is the price of a 40 ft container house?

A 40 ft luxury container house is Rs 7,53,920 ex-GST at 8 ft wide, Rs 9,42,400 at 10 ft and Rs 11,18,976 at 12 ft. The width, not the length, is what moves the figure most.

Is a container house legal in India?

It is treated as a structure, so the local municipal or panchayat building bylaws, setbacks and zoning apply exactly as they would to any other building of that footprint. Confirm the position for your plot before ordering.

How many people can a luxury container house sleep?

Two in the 20 ft sizes, two to three in the 40 x 8 ft, two to four in the 40 x 10 ft, and four to six in the 40 x 12 ft, which is the only size in the range with two bedrooms.

Which size has a separate bedroom with a door?

The 20 x 12 ft at 240 sq ft is the first size with a fully enclosed bedroom door and a separated shower zone. Below that, the sleeping end is screened rather than closed.

What is the warranty on a SAMAN luxury container house?

The structural warranty is 10 years and the finishing warranty is 1 year, extendable to 2, on the terms stated in the signed quotation and handover documents.

How long does delivery take?

Lead time is 7 to 21 working days from the confirmed order and approved drawing. Delivery is free within Bangalore city and across Delhi NCR including Ghaziabad, Gurugram, Faridabad, Noida and Greater Noida.

applicationsContent.h2: The six luxury container house sizes, 160 to 480 sq ft
applicationsContent.intro: Six sizes, each drawn as a measured cutaway with its own room and opening schedule. Pick by what has to fit.

panels.h3: 20 x 8 ft luxury container house: the 160 sq ft suite
panels.paragraph: The smallest luxury build is a single volume read end to end: a 56 sq ft living zone at the entry, a 4'-6" kitchen run with a wall-fixed two-seat dining ledge, a 5'-6" x 3'-0" shower room, and a 49 sq ft sleeping alcove behind a slatted screen rather than a door. It suits a resort cottage, a farm-stay unit or a guest suite beside an existing house, where one couple is the whole brief and the plot cannot give up more footprint.
applications: Built-up 160 sq ft; internal clear 19'-6" x 7'-6" with an 8'-0" ceiling
Living 56 sq ft, sleeping alcove 49 sq ft, shower room 16 sq ft
Three glazed openings on the front wall, largest 6'-0" x 5'-0"
One split-AC provision serves the whole shell; shower-room exhaust separate
No island, no enclosed bedroom door and no utility bay at this size
Rs 4,36,480 ex-GST, ex-works; Rs 5,15,046 including 18% GST

image.alt: 3D cutaway general arrangement drawing of the 20 x 8 ft luxury container house with room and opening schedules

panels.h3: 20 x 10 ft luxury container house: the 200 sq ft reference
panels.paragraph: Two extra feet of width change what the plan can hold. The living zone grows to 76 sq ft and takes a proper media wall, the kitchen gains a tall fridge bay and a two-stool breakfast bar, and the sleeping end becomes a 66 sq ft bedroom with its own wardrobe run rather than an alcove. This is the size the price ladder is calibrated on, so it is the cleanest reference point for comparing the luxury build against the standard one.
applications: Built-up 200 sq ft; internal clear 19'-6" x 9'-6" with an 8'-0" ceiling
Living 76 sq ft, bedroom 66 sq ft, kitchen and bar 25 sq ft, shower room 18 sq ft
A 7'-0" x 5'-0" living picture window is the largest opening at this size
Split-AC provision to the bedroom and a second point over the living zone
Acoustic infill in the bedroom partition; the alcove sizes below do not carry it
Rs 4,96,000 ex-GST, ex-works; Rs 5,85,280 including 18% GST

image.alt: 3D cutaway general arrangement drawing of the 20 x 10 ft luxury container house with room and opening schedules

panels.h3: 20 x 12 ft luxury container house: a suite with a real lounge
panels.paragraph: At 240 sq ft the plan separates for the first time. An 80 sq ft lounge and a 40 sq ft dining zone are distinct rooms rather than one long space, the kitchen takes an L-return with a tall fridge bay, and the 63 sq ft bedroom closes behind a door with a bathroom next to it instead of a shower pod. Buyers choose this size when the unit has to host guests in the evening and still read as a private residence afterwards.
applications: Built-up 240 sq ft; internal clear 19'-6" x 11'-6" with an 8'-0" ceiling
Lounge 80 sq ft, dining 40 sq ft, bedroom 63 sq ft, enclosed bathroom 19 sq ft
An 8'-0" x 6'-0" lounge slider plus a glazed 3'-6" entrance door
First size with a free-standing dining table rather than a wall-fixed ledge
First size with a fully enclosed bedroom door and a separated shower zone
Rs 5,71,392 ex-GST, ex-works; Rs 6,74,243 including 18% GST

image.alt: 3D cutaway general arrangement drawing of the 20 x 12 ft luxury container house with room and opening schedules

panels.h3: 40 x 8 ft luxury container house: the linear villa room
panels.paragraph: Forty feet on an eight-foot body gives length instead of width, and the plan is read as a sequence: 82 sq ft of living, a 68 sq ft kitchen and dining zone, a bath and utility bay, a corridor, then a 101 sq ft bedroom at the far end. It is the size for a narrow plot or a boundary wall, and the first one that carries a washing-machine bay, which matters when the unit is let out rather than used at weekends.
applications: Built-up 320 sq ft; internal clear 39'-6" x 7'-6" with an 8'-0" ceiling
Bedroom 101 sq ft, living 82 sq ft, kitchen and dining 68 sq ft
Five openings distributed along the 40'-0" front wall so every zone is daylit
Combined 6'-0" x 4'-6" bath and utility with a washer bay and two floor traps
A 3'-0" corridor separates the wet core from the bedroom; the 20 ft sizes have none
Rs 7,53,920 ex-GST, ex-works; Rs 8,89,626 including 18% GST

image.alt: 3D cutaway general arrangement drawing of the 40 x 8 ft luxury container house with room and opening schedules

panels.h3: 40 x 10 ft luxury container house: the one-bedroom villa
panels.paragraph: Four hundred square feet is where the plan stops compromising. Living at 114 sq ft and dining at 66 sq ft are separate zones, the kitchen runs 42 sq ft with a working peninsula and a tall fridge bay, and the bedroom is 128 sq ft, the largest single room in the range below the flagship. It is the usual choice for a permanent second residence or a long-stay rental where one bedroom is enough but nothing else should feel small.
applications: Built-up 400 sq ft; internal clear 39'-6" x 9'-6" with an 8'-0" ceiling
Bedroom 128 sq ft, living 114 sq ft, dining 66 sq ft, kitchen 42 sq ft
Two large living openings plus dedicated dining and kitchen windows
Kitchen peninsula and a separate four-seat dining zone; not available below 400 sq ft
Combined 7'-0" x 3'-6" bath and utility with a washer bay and two floor traps
Rs 9,42,400 ex-GST, ex-works; Rs 11,12,032 including 18% GST

image.alt: 3D cutaway general arrangement drawing of the 40 x 10 ft luxury container house with room and opening schedules

panels.h3: 40 x 12 ft luxury container house: the two-bedroom flagship
panels.paragraph: The 480 sq ft build is the only size in the range with two bedrooms: an 86 sq ft master and a 75 sq ft second room, both served by a wet core reached through a 2'-6" dressing lobby so nobody crosses the master to get to it. The living end runs 138 sq ft, dining seats six, and the kitchen takes a free-standing island. Buyers take this size when the unit has to work as a family residence rather than a couple's retreat.
applications: Built-up 480 sq ft; internal clear 39'-6" x 11'-6" with an 8'-0" ceiling
Master bedroom 86 sq ft, bedroom 2 75 sq ft, living 138 sq ft, dining 80 sq ft
Only size in the range with two bedrooms and a dressing lobby to the wet core
Only size with a free-standing kitchen island alongside a six-seat dining zone
An 8'-0" x 6'-0" living slider, the largest opening published on this page
Rs 11,18,976 ex-GST, ex-works; Rs 13,20,392 including 18% GST
